jobs.work: Full tear-off and replacement, Day 1 of 2 — tear off 2 layers of old shingles, 28 squares; inspect decking, replaced 6 sheets of soft/rotted decking; synthetic underlayment over the whole deck; ice & water shield in both valleys and around the chimney

Storm-damage inspection and emergency tarp — wind-lifted and creased shingles on the back slope; 12 x 16 ft emergency tarp over the exposed decking; photos of all damage taken for the homeowner's insurance claim

Full replacement, Day 2 of 2 — install architectural shingles (weathered wood), 28 squares; new drip edge all the way around; ridge vent along the main ridge; new flashing at the chimney and both plumbing vents; final walkthrough with the homeowner
Chimney flashing repair — replaced rusted step flashing around the chimney; installed a chimney cricket to move water off the back side; sealed and matched shingles around the repair
Metal roof install, Day 1 of 2 — standing-seam metal, 24 squares; tear off the old shingles; high-temp underlayment over the whole deck; panels run on the front slope
Leak repair — leak traced to a cracked plumbing-vent boot; new vent boot and flashing installed; replaced 1 sheet of water-damaged decking under the vent
Metal roof install, Day 2 of 2 — panels on the back slope; ridge cap and all trim pieces; final magnet sweep for screws
Gutter replacement — remove old gutters; 112 ft of new seamless gutters; 4 new downspouts
Storm-damage inspection — full roof inspection with photos; written replacement estimate for the homeowner and their insurance company
Leak inspection — find the leak source in the attic and on the roof; written repair quote before we leave
Shingle repair — replace wind-damaged shingles on the front slope, about 2 squares; reseal the ridge cap
